text: Kernel optimization spends most of its time waiting for the model to finish thinking.
Spec Gen watches for concrete design decisions.
The same reasoning prefix seeds several candidates.
Fast generations turn these ideas into kernels, while the main reasoning continues.
Each candidate is compiled, checked for correctness, and then profiled on the GPU.
When a candidate beats the historical average, the main generation stops early.
Otherwise, the main path continues. Feedback guides the next iteration.
An elastic pool moves GPUs to the work at iteration boundaries.
A shared cache reuses reasoning, instead of recomputing it.
Less waiting. More useful feedback. Better kernels. This is Spec Gen.
